topic: Optimizing traffic data queries for display
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining SQL queries used to calculate and display traffic analytics, specifically 'Viewable Impressions per face'.

Initial query versions were reviewed due to issues with data duplication (double-counting) when aggregating over multiple weeks. The first version summed records for every day in the period, leading to inflated totals.

The second query structure was deemed more appropriate because it calculates averages (`avgIf`) and groups by `day_of_week`, which is suitable for displaying average metrics across any arbitrary time period (e.g., two weeks).

It was confirmed that the logic required calculating a simple daily average over the selected date range, rather than summing raw records.
decisions: The second SQL query structure will be used for displaying traffic analytics.
The calculation should use averages grouped by day of week to handle non-standard time periods.
action_items: Implement the necessary change using the revised query logic.
